Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** a namespaced report or dataset cannot be named by typing, so the publish gate later refuses the name.
- **For the claimant:** The landing is `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`. Normalize on commit, not per keystroke, as the object designer does. Serial with PR #12745 (#12680).

Claim: PM loop round 2

Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12746`

Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, the Name field's commit while typing (a loose form per keystroke, the strict form where the value is judged, as `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx` does with `toFieldNameLoose`); the name helper module only if the loose form must be shared from it; tests beside each; one `.changeset/12746-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (designer only; no export, prop or type changes)
Responsibility: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s report and dataset designers commit Name with the strict `toFieldName` on every keystroke, which strips a trailing underscore before the next key arrives, so `qavrf_rev` typed key by key reads `qavrfrev` | none covers it: the object designer's `toFieldNameLoose` is not used there | every author who names a namespaced report or dataset by typing, measured in Chromium by the objectui#12680 dev (the card's source, PR #12745); the commits stand on `main` `3e2c763` (`ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:483`, `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx:504`)
Thread-read: 6222734497
Serial constraints cleared: PR objectui#12745 (objectui#12680, this seat), which triage named as serial, landed `1d86919`. objectui#12696 (closed) is no longer on these files. No in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` or `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and all 5 open PRs' file lists 2026-10-16T20:17Z.
